description.value: 50th Parallel Estate is an award-winning Okanagan estate winery specializing in Pinot Noir and aromatic white wines, set in Lake Country along a popular cycling corridor between Kelowna and Vernon. The property includes the Block One fine-dining restaurant focused on regional-seasonal ingredients, wine caves open for exploration, and a tasting room with appointment and walk-in options. Event and wedding venues accommodate groups from 10 to 350 people, making it a notable destination stop on a multi-day Okanagan cycling tour.
